career: Senior policy analyst for a New York State legislative committee on consumer protection, sports regulation, and live-event ticketing
bio: Idris Vaziri spends his workdays parsing ticketing complaints, combat-sports licensing rules, and consumer pricing data for live events around New York. After hours, he keeps a tight rotation of interests: Hot 97 clips, Terence Crawford and Canelo analysis, old Pacquiao-Márquez fights, and the occasional ONE Championship card.
